explanation: The men were conscripted rather than recruited. The Estado Novo ordered compulsory enlistment in 1943 through SEMTA, based at Fortaleza, and created SAVA, SESP, SNAPP and the Rubber Credit Bank around it. On Wikipedia's account, Vargas reduced the problem of a drought-stricken Northeast and increased the settlement of the Amazon at the same time. Thousands were transported under force to obligatory servitude and about thirty thousand died there.
